title: Clementine UVVIS
description: Global lunar surface chemistry maps derived from Clementine UVVIS spectral data. Includes oxide abundance maps (FeO, TiO2, Al2O3, MgO, CaO) and derived indices (Mg#) produced by 1D CNN inversion models calibrated against Apollo, Luna, and Chang'E mission samples.

links.title: Qiu et al. 2025 — CNN oxide maps with Chang'E-6 calibration
